Title Terminology Preset

Selects the cultural rank and landed-title terminology loaded from bellum_title_styles_*.xml. The selected preset is applied after the main hierarchy file, while compatibility patches still apply last. Additional preset files are discovered when the game starts. Default: Anglicized.
Use Sovereign Titles as Realm Names

When enabled, realm names follow the current sovereign title. When disabled, configured and Bellum title-founded realms retain their identity while their rank updates. Unknown realm names remain unchanged unless configured. Cultural title presets apply in both modes. Temporary rebellion and feud names are unchanged. Default: Off.

Show Debug Messages In Game
Shows Bellum Civile debug traces in the in-game message feed when those traces request visible output.
Rebellious Intent Threshold

The rebellious intent a clan needs to form or join a rebel faction. Leaders disband and members reconsider their commitment below half this value. Higher values make conspiracies slower and rarer. Default: 100.
Rebellious Intent Gain
Base daily gain while a rebel faction is strong enough to pressure the crown. Default: 2.
Rebellious Intent Decay
Daily loss when a rebel faction is too weak to keep pressure on the crown. Default: 1.
Rebel Leader Rivalry Threshold
Minimum relation required to join or remain with a cause-driven rebel leader. More negative values make lords tolerate worse rivals. Default: -50.
Enable War & Peace Logic Revamp

When enabled, Bellum uses its War Will, target-ranking, War Score, and peace-parley systems to control war and peace politics. Disable this to return war and peace proposals and vote support to vanilla Bannerlord. Default: On.
Enable Campaign Map War Score Widget

Shows every active conflict involving the player's current realm at the top-right of the campaign map, using the opposing realm's banner and Bellum War Score. This includes foreign wars, civil wars, and claim feuds in which the player is a participant. Requires the War & Peace Logic Revamp. Default: On.
Enable Campaign Map Client State Widget
When the player rules a suzerain realm, shows its client kingdoms at the top-left of the campaign map with their current Liberty Desire. Requires the War & Peace Logic Revamp. Default: On.
Minimum War Duration

Minimum number of days a conflict must last before voluntary peace proposals or exhaustion-based internal resolutions become available. A value of 0 disables this waiting period. Decisive resolution at maximum War Score is unaffected. Default: 30.
Minimum Peace Before Renewed War

Minimum number of days two realms must remain at peace before Bellum's AI will consider another offensive against the same realm. A value of 0 disables this waiting period. Client liberation wars remain exempt. Default: 20.
Reparations per War Score
Denars paid as immediate reparations for each War Score spent on the treaty term. A value of 0 disables reparations. Default: 5,000 denars per War Score.
Daily Tribute per War Score
Denars paid each day for 100 days for every War Score spent on the treaty term. A value of 0 disables tribute. Default: 250 denars per day per War Score.
Initial War Will
Starting War Will assigned to clans when Bellum first evaluates them. Default: 45.
Clan Evaluation Interval
Days between each clan refreshing its preferred foreign targets. War Will itself continues to change daily. Higher values reduce target-scoring work and slow political reaction. Default: 7.
War Will Event Memory
Days remembered War Will event pressures remain visible in debug reports and future treaty logic. Default: 84.
War Proposal Threshold
Minimum War Will a clan needs before it can propose a war through the revamp. Default: 75.
Peace Proposal Threshold
Maximum War Will a clan can have before it becomes willing to propose peace. Lower values make lords fight longer. Default: 25.
Mutual White Peace Threshold
Both sides must have a power-weighted average War Will at or below this value before a stalemated conflict can seek white peace. Default: 25.
Attacker War-Start Shock
Base War Will gained by clans on the side that declares war before ideology and trait modifiers. Default: 10.
Defender War-Start Shock
Base War Will gained by clans when their realm is attacked before ideology and trait modifiers. Default: 25.
Extra Conflict Daily Drain

Additional daily War Will decay per weighted simultaneous conflict, before ideology modifiers. Foreign wars after the first count once, civil wars count twice, and active feuds count as half a conflict. Default: 0.50.
Multiple-Front War Will Shock

War Will lost when a realm enters another conflict while already burdened by war or internal strife, per weighted existing conflict. Militarists suffer less and populists suffer more. The total one-time loss is capped at 30. Default: 10.
Visible Target Minimum Score
Minimum score for a realm to appear in a clan's ranked war target list. Default: 10.
Local Land Border Weight
Target score added when the clan personally holds lands bordering the target realm by land. Default: 25.
Local Maritime Border Weight
Target score added when the clan personally holds ports close to the target realm by sea. Requires War Sails/Naval DLC systems. Default: 20.
Realm Land Frontier Weight
Target score added when the realm borders the target by land but this clan does not personally hold the frontier. Default: 8.
Realm Maritime Route Weight
Target score added when the realm has a maritime route to the target but this clan does not personally hold the relevant ports. Default: 6.
Strong Claim Target Weight
Target score added when a clan has a strong claim to a title held by the target realm. Default: 45.
Weak Claim Target Weight
Target score added when a clan has a weak claim to a title held by the target realm. Default: 25.
De Jure Occupation Target Weight
Target score added when the target realm occupies a title legally owned by the evaluating clan. Default: 35.
Alliance Target Penalty
Target score penalty against realms with a formal alliance. Default: -50.
Trade Agreement Target Penalty
Target score penalty against realms with a trade agreement. Default: -8.
Foreign Marriage Tie Penalty
Target score penalty when the evaluating clan has marriage ties inside the target realm. Default: -10.
Ruling Marriage Tie Penalty
Target score penalty when the evaluating clan has marriage ties to the target realm's ruling clan. Default: -15.
Battle Shock Multiplier
Multiplier applied to War Will shocks from battle victories, battle defeats, and noble deaths in battle. Default: 1.
Raid Shock Multiplier
Multiplier applied to War Will shocks from raids. Default: 1.
Settlement Shock Multiplier
Multiplier applied to War Will shocks from settlement losses, captures, and achieved claim objectives. Default: 1.
Captivity Shock Multiplier
Multiplier applied to War Will shocks from captured nobles, heirs, and rulers. Default: 1.
Retained Prisoner Dungeon Escape Chance
Base daily escape chance, as a percentage, for nobles retained in a settlement dungeon after a Bellum peace treaty. Governor and captor perks still apply. Default: 1%.
Retained Prisoner Mobile Escape Chance
Base daily escape chance, as a percentage, for nobles retained in a mobile party after a Bellum peace treaty. Prisoner and captor perks still apply. Default: 3%.

Enable NPC Subterfuge Missions
When enabled, AI rulers can spend gold on covert subterfuge against neighboring realms and active rebellions. Player subterfuge missions remain available either way. Default: On.
Court Meeting Minimum Interval
Minimum days between court faction meetings. Default: 14.
Court Meeting Random Extra Days
Random extra days added to the minimum meeting interval. Default: 22.
Court Motion Override Cost
Influence paid by a court faction leader to block or replace a faction motion. AI rulers who lead a dissatisfied faction use this cost to protect the realm from its hostile motions. Default: 100.
Policy Mandate Days
Days a player faction leader has to propose an aligned policy after forcing a policy mandate. Default: 5.
Political Deliberation Days
Days before delayed policy, fief, and expulsion votes fire. One shared value keeps major votes paced consistently. Default: 5.
Rebellion Suppression Minimum Cost
Influence needed to restrain a faction at the start of rebellious mood. Default: 100.
Rebellion Suppression Maximum Cost
Influence needed to restrain a faction at the most extreme rebellious mood. Default: 500.
Grand Coalition Join Mood Threshold

Court factions at or below this mood can be swept into another faction's grand coalition. For reference, -21 or worse is angry enough for obstruction and negative court actions, while -60 or worse is considered openly rebellious. Default: -60.
Political Bribe Cost Multiplier
Multiplier applied to Bellum Civile policy, fief, and expulsion vote bribe costs. Default: 1.
Post-War Execution Chance
Base chance that a defeated clan leader is executed during post-war tribunal logic. Default: 10%. If execution fails, confiscation is checked next; if both fail, the clan is pardoned.
Post-War Confiscation Chance
Base chance that a defeated clan has one fief confiscated if execution does not fire. Default: 20%. If execution and confiscation both fail, the clan is pardoned.
Enable Indictments of Treason
When enabled, NPC rulers periodically review disloyal vassals, call expulsion votes at -60 relations, and decree treason purges at -100. Manual player actions remain available. Default: On.
Enable Partition Succession
When enabled, large noble clans, including the player clan, can split spare inherited fiefs into cadet branches after clan succession.
Main Heir Reserved Personal Holdings
Number of personal barony-level holdings the main heir keeps after the primary title chain is preserved. Spare title packages and fiefs can split into cadet branches. Default: 1.
Minimum Titles to Form Higher Title
Minimum number of contiguous same-rank titles needed to form a higher title. Lower values create denser title hierarchies that better fit Calradia's map density. Default: 2.
Claim Fabrication Baseline Years
Baseline number of in-game years required to fabricate a claim before the fabricator's Stewardship, Roguery, and personality traits modify progress. Default: 3 years.
Fabricated Claim Discovery Chance
Base discovery chance before skills and council modifiers. The second and third milestones add 3 and 6 percentage points of discovery risk. Default: 10%.

Enable Rebellious Army Refusal
When enabled, openly rebellious court factions and vassals with very poor relations refuse calls to arms.
Army Refusal Threshold
Court faction mood or vassal relation at or below this value refuses calls to arms. Default: -60.
Restrict Army Calls to Vassals

When enabled, non-ruler nobles can only summon clans within their de facto title authority. Rulers and temporary Bellum war leaders can still summon their full side. Disable this to keep vanilla-style army pooling.
Personal Army Favor Relation
Minimum relation at which a lord outside your de facto authority may answer your call for friendship's sake, either through the army menu or in person. Default: 60.
Enable Strategic Marriage Logic

When enabled, Bellum adds strategic NPC marriage logic for dynastic survival, royal pacification, and foreign royal alliances. Disable this if you want vanilla or another mod to fully control NPC marriages.
Block Vanilla Dice-Roll Marriage Logic
When enabled, Bellum blocks vanilla NPC-to-NPC marriage rolls so only Bellum's strategic marriage logic handles NPC marriages. Default: enabled.
Male Minimum Marriage Age
Minimum age for male nobles to be considered by Bellum's strategic NPC marriage logic. This cannot fall below the active adulthood age. Default: 25.
Female Minimum Marriage Age
Minimum age for female nobles to be considered by Bellum's strategic NPC marriage logic. This cannot fall below the active adulthood age. Default: 25.
Female Maximum Marriage Age
Maximum age for female nobles to be considered by Bellum's strategic NPC marriage logic. Default: 41.
Enable Relationship Memory
When enabled, noble relations combine a natural political baseline with lasting, timed memories of favors and grievances. Hero encyclopedia pages show the full breakdown.
Legacy Relation Fade
Migration-only rate used to preserve the former weekly drift of relationship history stored in older saves.
